name: mxfp8_weight_prequant
description: Hoist MX-FP8 weight quantisation out of the hot forward path by pre-quantising once per optimiser step (not per forward). Biggest single lever for training-step speedup with gradient accumulation.
preconditions: Training loop with gradient accumulation (k >= 2 micro-batches per optimiser step)
Weights constant across micro-batches within a step (standard optimiser behaviour)
MX-FP8 grouped GEMM used for forward + backward
steps: Implement MXFP8WeightPrequant container holding: bf16_source + (fp8_fwd, scale_fwd) + (fp8_dgrad, scale_dgrad)
Expose prequant_mxfp8_weights(w_bf16) -> MXFP8WeightPrequant — runs both weight-quant kernels, retains bf16 source reference for autograd
Autograd Function accepts either bf16 Tensor or MXFP8WeightPrequant — unwrap in the public dispatcher
Pass prequant as extra (None-filled when absent) positional args to autograd.Function.apply — tuples or custom objects aren't differentiable, tensors are
Return None for the 4 prequant-tensor slots in backward's return tuple
In training loop: call prequant once per optimiser step, pass wrapper to all k micro-batches, let optimiser.step() implicitly invalidate by modifying w_bf16
expected_impact: 1.21x -> 1.53x bf16 training step at k=8 accumulation on gpt_oss_20B. Inference forward: 1.18x -> 1.54x bf16 when weights cached. B weight quant (~0.6 ms) amortised k-fold.
decision_rules: Use when weights are re-used across >=2 forwards per optimiser step (k-accum >= 2 or shared-weight module called repeatedly).
DO NOT use if weights change between forwards (e.g. per-batch quant-aware training with perturbation).
